Theorem
[Boundary criterion for degenerate ellipticity] 1. ch6:6.25\group gt-ch06 If $L$ is elliptic in a $C^2$ domain, $c\le 0$, and $a^{ij},b^i/\lambda ,c,f/\lambda \in C^\alpha (\Omega )\cap C^0(\bar\Omega )$, with $\Sigma _1\cup \Sigma _2=\partial \Omega $, then every $\varphi \in C^0(\partial \Omega )$ gives a unique solution $u\in C^2(\Omega )\cap C^0(\bar\Omega )$.
